title: feat(events): formal specification and transactional foundation
body:
# PR draft: Event operations formal specification and transactional foundation

## Scope

- Audit the existing event ecosystem and define the canonical integration boundary.
- Add bounded TLA+/PlusCal and Alloy models plus a reproducible, checksum-pinned gate.
- Add an additive PostgreSQL event-operations foundation around `social_event` and existing logistics
  activities/dependencies.
- Close authenticated event-invitation create/read/update authorization gaps.

## Dependency

Base: local `origin/main` at `17a33eca11d585d84435af85340beece9b51d14e`. This is the first PR in
the planned chain; later API/UI/resource/engagement/finance work depends on it. Do not merge until the
remote CI job and backend suite reproduce the local evidence.

## Requirements and invariants

- EO-003/007/008/009: explicit ownership/grants, visibility/lifecycle policy, revisions/audit.
- EO-023–028: event-local acyclic dependencies, exactly one Accountable, at least one Responsible,
  no silent orphan, dependency-gated completion, version-bound audited override.
- EO-033–038/041–044: reservation race, exact contract version, milestone/payout/idempotency models.
- EO-045/047/051: contextual authorization, invitation attenuation/replay, stale/offline terminal
  behavior.

Traceability: `docs/event-operations/traceability-matrix.md`.

## Schema and migration effects

- Adds event lifecycle policy/state sidecar, ownership/coproduction relations, scoped grants,
  migration issues, revisions, sessions, command receipts, audit events, transitions, invitation
  security metadata, task policy, RACI assignments, and task overrides.
- Backfills only deterministic legacy lifecycle/owner facts. Missing/unresolved ownership creates an
  issue and remains disabled for activation; it is never guessed.
- Adds advisory-lock/cycle and opted-in completion triggers to existing logistics tables.
- Does not alter or delete existing event, RSVP, ticket, logistics, directory, resource, booking,
  commerce, ledger, review, chat, or notification records.

## Security and privacy effects

- Event invitation creation becomes organizer/admin-only.
- Non-managers list only invitations addressed to their authenticated party.
- Recipients can accept/decline but cannot transfer invitations or edit organizer messages.
- New audit/revision/receipt/transition/override rows reject update/delete.
- Guest token material is designed for SHA-256 digests only; the complete external guest flow remains
  disabled/unimplemented.

## Tests and formal checks executed

- `npm run verify:event-operations:formal`: PASS with exact counts/bounds in the formal README.
- `npm run test:event-operations-foundation-migration`: PASS on ephemeral PostgreSQL 16.
- `npm run verify:formal`: PASS, 0 critical/errors; 351 pre-existing/advisory warnings.
- `npm run test:formal`: PASS, 4/4.
- Shell syntax, JSON parse, workflow YAML parse, and `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Linked Hspec binary, `social event handler helpers`: PASS, 31 examples/0 failures.
- Linked Hspec binary, atomic/idempotent moment-reaction test: PASS, 1 example/0 failures.
- The `stack test` wrapper compiled and linked all 203 modules, then failed during Cabal copy/register
  because it expected an unrelated `tdf-hq-exe` artifact that target did not build; it is not claimed
  as a passing wrapper command.
- `npm run quality:repo`: 41/42 loop tests passed; the remaining test could not load the declared but
  uninstalled `@testomatio/reporter/jest` dependency. Formal audit within the command passed with
  0 critical/errors. Re-run after a clean dependency install in CI.
- Remote CI was unavailable during the initial local implementation. GitHub access later
  recovered; publication/check status is tracked separately in the delivery report.

## Rollback

Deploy application rollback first. The SQL rollback removes the two triggers installed on legacy
logistics tables and retains all additive ownership/audit/invitation/RACI data for a safe roll-forward.
No destructive down migration is supplied for immutable operational history. The migration is not in
the production manifest in this PR.

## Remaining limitations/manual steps

- The original task completion/RACI guards are insufficient under relation replacement and
  concurrent responsibility removal. The dependent PR 04 supplies the modeled and DB-tested
  correction; do not activate the task sidecar from this foundation alone.
- No typed foundation API or generated client yet; no new workspace UI/mobile surface.
- No external invitation issue/accept/revoke worker, no resource binding/capacity path, and no
  event-engagement/contract/payment orchestration yet.
- Legal/accounting/security review and sandbox provider certification remain mandatory.
- All production providers, payouts, rollout flags, and production migration operations remain off.


## Integration/CI repair update — 2026-09-16

Current head: `d99777d54088ec16e809bf3574e166c570fcd180`; includes main `d4bd497df6979f639dcd112e4f60b57f3526b9e0` through normal merges. Earlier head `c2b7ba65fc8bc86c9cdd593c262e3ec9e8504deb` is preserved.

| Check | Before | Current evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Backend quality | Six configuration failures from job-wide fixture PGPASSWORD | Scoped fixture password to the PostgreSQL runner; local configuration reproduction 109 examples/6 failures before, 109/0 after. Final full local/CI validation pending. |
| PostgreSQL foundation | Sessions could reference another event's revision | Validated composite foreign key; full apply/reapply/concurrency/rollback suite passes, including rejection and unchanged state. |
| CI runner policy | Fixture password leaked into general tests | 14 focused tests pass; actual PostgreSQL and owned-only cleanup remain mandatory. |
| Release contract | Main migration ancestry follow-up | #404 integrated; 60 release/entrypoint tests pass locally. |
| Formal verification | Previously green | [Final-head verification passed](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35130845145). |
| Repository/UI/mobile/persona/API/migrations/aggregate | Earlier head superseded | [Final-head CI](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35130845150) is being observed; pending jobs are not green. |
| Catalog/safe install/Datadog | Earlier passes | Final-head workflows are being observed separately. |

Commands executed: focused `loadConfig` before/after; `node --test scripts/__tests__/ci-pipeline.test.mjs`; `sh scripts/test-event-operations-foundation-migration.sh`; `npm run test:production-release`. Full Stack and UI quality remain running under severe host load. Please wait for verified local results and final-head CI before merging.

Changes cover CI fixture setup/helper/regressions, session/revision SQL integrity, PostgreSQL regression and repair documentation. Existing incompatible revisions abort installation instead of rewriting data. The preserve-data rollback retains relational tables, constraints and history. Concurrent invitation/dependency repairs remain intact. No force-push, deployment, secret change, provider activation or weakened check. Main is not claimed green from an unmerged PR.


## September 16 graph-approval and main reconciliation update

Current head: `00f796e74da9e9ec9417ead93980b8a8e71d5fcc`; main integrated: `16a4eef7477eb160feb20210406f70adb58be814` (normal merge, no rewritten history).

| Check / defect | Before | Verified after / current status |
|---|---|---|
| Open-task graph override | Old approval incorrectly permitted completion after adding a blocked dependency | PostgreSQL regression fails before and passes after immutable graph-snapshot binding; [final-head foundation and formal CI passed](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35144444855) |
| Catalog authority | Main merge conflicts between independently reviewed records | Preserved both records, strict JSON/CSV regeneration passed; [final-head audit passed](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35144445036) |
| Datadog | Requires final-head verification | [Passed](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35144444908) |
| Full CI | Previous head passed | [New main integration running](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35144444939); not yet green |
| Container build | Previous d99777d head passed | [Final-head image run requested](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35144669265); not yet green |

Changed subsystems: opt-in foundation SQL, SQL regression runner, event-operations runbook; main integration retains social/mobile changes and individually reviewed catalog records. No trigger, matrix, quality threshold or provider activation was weakened.

Local evidence before the new main integration: full Stack executable/test build, 2,547 examples/0 failures; UI lint/types/1,992 tests/production build passed after one bounded load-related retry with unchanged deadlines. After integration: repository quality and strict catalogs passed. New full Stack/UI validations are running, so earlier results are not claimed as final-tree validation. Complete SQL apply/idempotence/concurrency/rollback/reapply tests, including final immutable-snapshot assertions, passed on isolated native PostgreSQL16.10. Local Docker timed out; its transport alone was replaced in a temporary test copy, while repository and CI Docker scripts remain unchanged. CI's actual Docker foundation suite passed on the final head.

Security/compatibility: approvals bind exact activity version and a DB-generated ordered edge snapshot under the shared write fence. Legacy NULL snapshots never manufacture authorization; an inconsistent legacy completed graph requires operator-reviewed remediation before migration can validate. Rollback retains approval/audit snapshots and capture metadata. No production database, secret, feature activation or deployment was changed.

Remaining: final full CI/image/local results and a fresh approving review (the push correctly dismissed the old approval). This PR remains unmerged; main is not claimed green from PR results.
